steps.content: Hya, Hya... Heaargh!!
Who is it...?
Aargh! Hya!!
Aaahhh!
Who is fighting?
Need to help her...

steps.speaker: (Transition)
steps.content: Black screen brightening slowly; eyes opening abruptly; bg: contaminated square

steps.speaker: (Subtitles)
steps.content: ??:?? Line of defense in Keylan Square

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, how are you feeling?

Not so good. Your head is buzzing. Your field of vision is filled with purple blazes all over the place. In the air some dark image comes on and off, but quivers into nothingness when you strain to see.
You can't ascertain for the moment if this is a post-traumatic visual malfunction or a sure sign of a corrupted world.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: How long have I been out?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Less than twenty minutes as far as our senses are concerned. But time here has been distorted too.

She passes you the watch. It says three in the afternoon, but the second hand is travelling abnormally fast. Then it comes back to you: A large-scale contamination incident broke out in Keylan Square at <color=#fb9259>10:42</color>.

Soldiers and sirens are gone, and so is the roar of the helicopters. Only the undulating howling of Corruptors can be heard. A film hangs above the neighborhood in the distance, making it fuzzy and misty, remote and dream-like.

You've been to the depths of many contamination sites, but this is a whole new vista. The contamination is not flowing out of a single source; instead, the whole space is being distorted and enveloped by the contamination all at once.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Hella needs rest. When you were knocked out cold by the contamination, Hella was somewhat affected because she's connected with you through the shackles.
Hecate's tone is even, but you notice that her voice is a lot weaker than usual.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What about you? You doing okay?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I'm fine. I can handle this level of impact.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Now that you've come around, Chief, the shackles are functioning normally again and the contamination is being suppressed. Hella will be all right.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: As for Earl, he wasn't affected. But he's worried about Zoya, so he didn't wait for you to wake up and left on his own.
Oh right... Zoya.
You remember the voice you heard in your unconscious state. It was a cry coming from the other end of the shackles. Someone's trapped in limbo and fighting a bitter fight.
You recall that before the blast knocked you out, you saw a certain object invade her consciousness, tearing at her soul. Its aura was too familiar, too twisted to be forgotten...
Was it the inheritance from the crypt?

How come it appeared in this place, out of nowhere, without any warning? 
Did Earl betray Zoya? Or is there some other force that you don't know about?

Thinking hard about these questions, you feel your scalp going numb. But at the same time, they are tempting you to move forward like a deadly bewitchment. What lies ahead might be an abyss, or the answers that you've longed for.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Go to Zoya. She's still there, fighting on her own.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...You still want to go deeper into the square? It's a maximum security area. If it ever becomes the center of a contamination outbreak, the density of Corruptors there will be far beyond any crisis we've witnessed.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: This contamination event is having a distinct effect on you too, Chief. What if...
Hecate, the shackles are unbreakable. If I sit this one out and something happens to Zoya, I'm not gonna be able to stay unharmed.
And I have a feeling that all this is just the beginning.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Got it. I'll go get Hella. A lot of battles await us.

In the contamination mist ahead, a few towering FAC machines have been turned on. Blue lights are cast in the direction of the center of the square, coalescing into a protective screen around it, as if anticipating the arrival of some unknown terror.
